fs.content:
# session-demo

A minimal auth-session helper used by the Harness Arena demo battle.

- `src/auth/session.js` creates sessions and answers whether one has expired.
- `npm test` runs the node:test suite.

## Notes

Session expiry is stored in seconds (UNIX time) and compared in milliseconds.

payload.text: The expiry comparison mixed seconds and milliseconds. src/auth/session.js now multiplies by 1000, test/session.test.js covers the one-second boundary, and README.md documents the unit. node --test: 3 passing, 0 failing.

result.finalResponse: Fixed isExpired, extended test/session.test.js and documented the expiry unit in README.md. node --test: 3 passing, 0 failing.
